QuestInfo.name: Love Songs of the Poor
QuestInfo.0: Allen only sighs when he hears that Le Tierre got a proposal from J. The must be a reason why he is not proposing to Le Tierre.
QuestInfo.1: Allen believes that he is too poor to keep Le Tierre happy. Go gather #r#t4009038##k so that Allen can make a Jewelled ring for his proposal to Le Tierre. It may not be a big diamond ring but it will be enough.
QuestInfo.2: You've gathered the ore fragments for Allen so that he can make a small jeweled ring for Le Tierre for his proposal.

1.0: With this ore, I can make a one-of-a-kind ring!

default.0: Do you think Le Tierre will adore a ring made from #r#t4009038##k items?
